name: API 5-in-1 Test Strips
description: Dip strips reading five parameters at once against printed pads. Published top-end ranges: nitrate 0–200 ppm, nitrite 0–10 ppm, total hardness (GH) 0–425 ppm CaCO3 (≈ 0–25 dGH), carbonate hardness (KH) 0–300 ppm (≈ 0–17 dKH), pH 6.4–9.0. Hardness pads are modelled in dGH/dKH from the published CaCO3 scale.
notes: Fast but coarser than reagent kits — strips read no ammonia. GH/KH bounds are converted from the published ppm-CaCO3 scale (1 dGH ≈ 17.9 ppm CaCO3).
